diff --git a/evals/evaluators/factory.py b/evals/evaluators/factory.py
index 1234567..abcdefg 100644
--- a/evals/evaluators/factory.py
+++ b/evals/evaluators/factory.py
@@ -1,10 +1,19 @@
-"""from __future__ import annotations
+"""evals/evaluators/factory.py - Factory for creating evaluators based on model name and strategy.
+
+This module provides functions to create instances of evaluators, allowing for easy swapping of evaluation strategies.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from evals.evaluators.base import Evaluator
+from evals.evaluators.code_block_evaluator import CodeBlockEvaluator, language_from_model_name
+from evals.evaluators.exact_match import ExactMatchEvaluator
+from evals.evaluators.ollama_judge import OllamaJudgeEvaluator
+from evals.evaluators.schema_evaluator import SchemaEvaluator
+
+__all__ = ["make_evaluator", "ExactMatchEvaluator", "SchemaEvaluator", "CodeBlockEvaluator", "OllamaJudgeEvaluator"]
+
+def make_evaluator(model_name: str, strategy: str = "auto") -> Evaluator:
+    """Create an evaluator based on model name and strategy."""
+    if strategy == "exact" or "exact" in model_name.lower():
+        return ExactMatchEvaluator()
+    elif strategy == "schema" or "schema" in model_name.lower():
+        return SchemaEvaluator()
+    elif strategy == "code_block" or "code" in model_name.lower():
+        return CodeBlockEvaluator()
+    elif strategy == "judge" or "judge" in model_name.lower():
+        return OllamaJudgeEvaluator()
+    return SchemaEvaluator()
+
